participation.context: Reported a damp post, two mornings, and no price, and kept the letter as it was.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Took threepence, refused another man's lease as kitchen business, and stopped the lost wife at the door of the plot.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked whether the house would come down, and dusted round the letter without opening it.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Sat at the table when damp was mentioned, and did not speak.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: a Shoreditch lease is not her rent and not her supper
relations.quote: I do not want a price for another woman's timber in my kitchen.

story.body: You told them the date and the two mornings. You did not name a sum. You left the Sunday letter folded, and Master Verbeke sat by and did not speak.

title: Told the house the post was damp
